title: Advance Ruling Application Framework
summary: The framework for Advance Rulings evolved to include specific procedural requirements for submission, fee payment via e-Challan, and strict timelines for processing and review.

evolution.procedure: Shifted from manual submission to digital-friendly channels and standardized fee payment via e-Challan.
evolution.legal_basis: Refined grounds for rejection and established a formal review process for aggrieved applicants.

timeline.change: Initial establishment of advance ruling application and rejection criteria.
Introduction of review mechanisms and detailed processing timelines.
Mandatory e-Challan fee payment and expanded submission channels (email/fax/courier).

member_objects.clause_title: অগ্রিম রুলিং জারী করা হইবে না এমন ক্ষেত্র
member_objects.resolved_text:
১০। অগ্রিম রুলিং জারী করা হইবে না এমন ক্ষেত্র।— (১) নিম্নবর্ণিত ক্ষেত্রসমূহে অগ্রিম রুলিং ইউনিট কোনরূপ অগ্রিম রুলিং জারী করিবে না, যথা:-
(ক) আবেদনে উল্লিখিত বিষয়টি কোন সরকারি সংস্থা, আদালত বা ট্রাইব্যুনালের নিকট বিবেচনাধীন বা বিচারাধীন থাকিলে;
(খ) আবেদনে উল্লিখিত বিষয়ে ইতোমধ্যে আদালত বা ট্রাইব্যুনাল সিদ্ধান্ত প্রদান করিলে; এবং
(গ) যে ক্ষেত্রে সকল বস্তুগত ঘটনা (material facts) যথাযথভাবে নিরূপণ করা সম্ভব নয়।
(২) অগ্রিম রুলিং ইউনিট কর্তৃক কোন আবেদন প্রত্যাখ্যান করা হইলে, প্রত্যাখ্যানের ভিত্তি (ground) পরিবর্তন না হওয়া পর্যন্ত একই ব্যক্তি একই পণ্য বা আইটেম সম্পর্কে নূতন করিয়া আবেদন করিতে পারিবেন না।

Advance Ruling Unit: The Advance Ruling Unit is restricted from issuing advance rulings in specific circumstances including when the matter is currently pending before a government agency, court, or tribunal.
The unit shall not issue rulings on matters where a court or tribunal has already reached a decision.
The unit is prohibited from issuing rulings when the material facts of the application cannot be adequately determined.
When an application is rejected by the Advance Ruling Unit, the applicant cannot file a new application for the same goods or items unless the grounds for the initial rejection have changed.
The Advance Ruling Unit is mandated to dispose of an application within a specified number of working days from the date of submission after reaching a decision under the relevant rules.
The unit is required to issue an advance ruling regarding the classification of goods by stating the ruling number and date of issuance if the decision is positive.
In cases where classification is not feasible, the unit must inform the applicant of the reasons within a set timeframe after the decision-making process.
The unit is required to prioritize electronic communication when issuing rulings or informing applicants of relevant information.

Advance ruling documents issued by the unit must contain specific details, including applicant information, submission dates, item descriptions, classification rationale, validity periods, and instructions for review or usage.
Advance Ruling: An advance ruling provides a formal determination regarding the classification of goods for an applicant.
The issuance of an advance ruling must include a specific validity period and clear instructions on how the recipient may request a review or apply the ruling.

১৪। অগ্রিম রুলিং এর রিভিউ।— (১) বিধি ৯ এর অধীন জারীকৃত অগ্রিম রুলিং অথবা বিধি ১৩ এর অধীন রুলিং এর সংশোধন, রদ বা বাতিল বিষয়ক সিদ্ধান্তে রুলিংধারী সংক্ষুব্ধ হইলে অগ্রিম রুলিং ইউনিটের নিকট উক্ত সিদ্ধান্ত রিভিউ এর জন্য লিখিতভাবে আবেদন করিতে পারিবে।
(২) রিভিউ এর আবেদন রুলিং প্রাপ্তির বা, ক্ষেত্রমত, রুলিং এর সংশোধন, রদ বা বাতিলের বিষয়ে অবহিত হইবার, তারিখ হইতে ৬০(ষাট) কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে দাখিল করিতে হইবে, এবং উহাতে উক্তরূপ আবেদনের যৌক্তিকতা সবিস্তারে উল্লেখ করিতে হইবে।
(৩) অগ্রিম রুলিং ইউনিট রিভিউ আবেদন প্রাপ্তির ৬০ (ষাট) কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে উহা নিষ্পত্তি করিবে।

Advance Ruling: A ruling holder may request a formal review of decisions regarding the issuance, amendment, revocation, or cancellation of an advance ruling.
The review application must be submitted to the Advance Ruling Unit within a specified period from the date of receiving the ruling or being notified of an amendment, revocation, or cancellation.
The applicant is required to provide a detailed explanation of the justification for the review in their written application.
Advance Ruling Unit: This body is responsible for accepting and processing formal review applications from affected parties concerning advance rulings.
The unit is mandated to conclude the review process and provide a decision within a specific number of working days upon receipt of the application.

তবে শর্ত থাকে যে, অগ্রিম রুলিং ইউনিট আবেদনকারীর আবেদনের প্রেক্ষিতে উক্ত সময়সীমা আরও ১৫ (পনের) দিন বর্ধিত করিতে পারিবে।
(৩) উপ-বিধি (২) অনুযায়ী চাহিত অতিরিক্ত তথ্য বা দলিলাদি আবেদনকারী নির্ধারিত সময়ের বা, ক্ষেত্রমত বর্ধিত সময়ের, যদি থাকে, মধ্যে দাখিল না করিলে আবেদন বাতিল বলিয়া গণ্য হইবে।
(৪) আবেদনটি পরীক্ষা এবং আবেদনের সহিত দাখিলকৃত তথ্য ও দলিলাদি এবং অতিরিক্ত তথ্য ও দলিলাদি, যদি থাকে, যাচাই-বাছাই করিয়া, অগ্রিম রুলিং ইউনিট অগ্রিম রুলিং বিষয়ে সিদ্ধান্ত গ্রহণ করিবে।
(৫) অগ্রিম রুলিং ইউনিট উপ-বিধি (৪) এর অধীন আবেদনপত্র ও দলিলাদি যাচাই বাছাইকালে প্রয়োজনে কোন তৃতীয় পক্ষ অথবা বিশেষজ্ঞ অথবা বিশেষায়িত প্রতিষ্ঠানের মতামত গ্রহণ এবং প্রযোজ্য ক্ষেত্রে আবেদনকারীর মৌখিক বক্তব্য গ্রহণ করিতে পারিবে।

Advance Ruling Unit: The Advance Ruling Unit is responsible for acknowledging the receipt of applications for advance rulings.
The unit performs a preliminary verification of applications and submitted documents and may request additional information within a specified timeframe.
The unit has the authority to grant extensions for the submission of requested documentation.
The unit evaluates the application, accompanying data, and any supplemental information to reach a formal decision on the request.
The unit is empowered to consult with third parties, experts, or specialized institutions and may hear oral presentations from the applicant during the evaluation process.
Advance Ruling Application: Applicants must undergo a verification process where they are required to submit any additional documentation requested by the authorities.
Applications are considered cancelled if the requested information or documents are not submitted by the applicant within the prescribed or extended time limits.

Advance Ruling Unit: The Advance Ruling Unit is required to finalize an application for an advance ruling within a specified number of working days after receiving the request.
When issuing an advance ruling, the unit must provide a decision regarding the classification of goods, including a ruling number and date of issuance.
If the classification of the goods is not possible, the unit must notify the applicant of the specific reasons for this inability within a fixed timeframe.
The unit is mandated to prioritize the use of electronic means when issuing rulings or communicating information to applicants.
Advance Ruling: An advance ruling document must contain mandatory information including applicant details, submission dates, product descriptions, classification justifications, validity periods, and instructions for re-consideration or usage.
The advance ruling acts as a formal determination of the classification of goods for the applicant.

(৭) আবেদন দাখিলের ৩০ (ত্রিশ) কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে অথবা, ক্ষেত্রমত, আবেদনকারী কর্তৃক বিধি ৮ এর উপ-বিধি (২) এর অধীন সময়সীমা বৃদ্ধির অনুরোধের প্রেক্ষিতে অগ্রিম রুলিং ইউনিট কর্তৃক বর্ধিত সময়ের মধ্যে উক্ত আবেদন প্রত্যাহার করা যাইবে।

Advance Ruling: Applicants must submit an application for an advance ruling using the prescribed forms either directly, by post, courier, email, or fax to the Advance Ruling Unit.
Applications must be filed at least sixty working days prior to the filing of a Bill of Entry or Bill of Export.
Applicants may submit multiple applications simultaneously, provided that each application is limited to a single product or item.
An applicant may request to provide oral testimony regarding the matter, which must be clearly stated in the application form.
Applications may be withdrawn by the applicant within thirty working days of submission or within any extended period granted by the Advance Ruling Unit.
Advance Ruling Unit: This authority is the designated body responsible for receiving applications and potentially granting extensions for the submission process.
Advance Ruling Fee: A fixed fee is required for an advance ruling application, which must be deposited through the designated government electronic payment system under the specified customs revenue code.
Proof of payment of this fee must be attached to the application.
Bill of Entry: The submission of an application for an advance ruling is subject to a minimum time requirement relative to the filing of a Bill of Entry.
Bill of Export: The submission of an application for an advance ruling is subject to a minimum time requirement relative to the filing of a Bill of Export.

(৪) আবেদনটি পরীক্ষা এবং আবেদনের সহিত দাখিলকৃত তথ্য ও দলিলপত্রাদি এবং অতিরিক্ত তথ্য ও দলিলপত্রাদি, যদি থাকে, যাচাই-বাছাই করিয়া, অগ্রিম রুলিং ইউনিট অগ্রিম রুলিং বিষয়ে সিদ্ধান্ত গ্রহণ করিবে।

Advance Ruling Unit: The Advance Ruling Unit is responsible for acknowledging the receipt of applications for advance rulings.
The unit performs a preliminary verification of applications and submitted documents within a specified timeframe and may request additional information from the applicant.
It holds the authority to extend the document submission period upon the applicant's request.
The unit makes final decisions on advance rulings after thorough verification of the application and all supporting documentation.
During the review process, the unit is authorized to consult with third parties, experts, or specialized institutions and may hear oral arguments from the applicant.
Advance Ruling: The process for obtaining an advance ruling involves a formal application process followed by verification and decision-making by the dedicated unit.
Failure to submit requested additional information or documentation within the prescribed or extended time limit results in the automatic cancellation of the application.

তারিখ: ১৮ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৯ বঙ্গাব্দ/ ১ জুন, ২০২২ খ্রিস্টাব্দ

এস,আর,ও নং ১৫৪-আইন/২০২২/১০২/কাস্টমস।— Customs Act, 1969 (Act No. IV of 1969) এর section 219, section 219A এর সহিত পঠিতব্য, এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড ২ জুন, ২০১৬ খ্রিস্টাব্দ মোতাবেক ১৯ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৩ বঙ্গাব্দ তারিখে জারিকৃত কাস্টমস রুলিং (অগ্রিম) বিধিমালা, ২০১৬ এর নিম্নরূপ অধিকতর সংশোধন করিল, যথা:-

উপরি-উক্ত বিধিমালার বিধি ৭ এর উপ-বিধি (৩) এর পরিবর্তে নিম্নবর্ণিত উপ-বিধি (৩) প্রতিস্থাপিত হইবে, যথা :-

“(৩) অগ্রিম রুলিং ফি বাবদ ২,০০০ (দুই হাজার) টাকা ‘এ-চালান’ এর মাধ্যমে ‘অন্যান্য কাস্টমস’ নামীয় খাতে ১/১১০৩/০০০০/০৯৬১ কোডে জমা প্রদানপূর্বক উহার প্রমাণক আবেদনের সহিত দাখিল করিতে হইবে।”।

Customs Act 1969: This act provides the enabling authority under Section 219 and 219A for the National Board of Revenue to amend customs rules.
National Board of Revenue: The board is empowered to issue and amend customs rules as part of its regulatory function.
Customs Ruling (Advance) Rules 2016: This set of rules undergoes a formal amendment regarding the application and fee submission procedure for advance rulings.
The amendment specifies that the fee must be paid through a prescribed government digital payment portal and the payment proof must accompany the application.

Advance Ruling: This term refers to a ruling issued under the specific sub-rule of these regulations.
Advance Ruling Unit: This term refers to the unit established under the specific rule governing its formation.
Identical Goods: These are goods that are the same in physical characteristics, quality, and reputation, produced in the same country, allowing for minor external differences that do not affect their classification.
Customs Act 1969: This is the parent legislation defined as the Act for the purposes of these regulations.
Application: This refers to any application submitted under the prescribed rule of these regulations.
Applicant: This refers to a person who submits an application for an advance ruling to the Board.
Customs, Excise and VAT Appellate Tribun: This entity is defined as the tribunal constituted under section 196 of the Customs Act.
Classification of Goods: This refers to the classification determined according to the Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System established by the World Customs Organization.
Form: This refers to the forms prescribed within these regulations.
National Board of Revenue: This is the Board constituted under the National Board of Revenue Order, 1972.
Person: This is defined in accordance with the definition provided in section 2(pp) of the Customs Act.
Ruling Holder: This refers to any person in whose favor an advance ruling has been issued.

Classification of Goods: Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System

Advance Ruling: An advance ruling is defined as the ruling issued under the specific sub-rule of these regulations.
Advance Ruling Unit: The advance ruling unit is the body formed under the provisions of these regulations to handle advance ruling requests.
Identical Goods: Identical goods refer to items produced in the same country that are physically the same as the goods being classified, with only minor aesthetic differences that do not impact classification.
Customs Act 1969: The term Act is defined as the Customs Act, 1969.
Advance Ruling Application: An application is defined as any request submitted in accordance with the relevant rule of these regulations.
Applicant: An applicant is defined as any person who submits a request to the National Board of Revenue for an advance ruling.
Customs, Excise and VAT Appellate Tribun: The Tribunal is defined as the Appellate Tribunal constituted under the relevant section of the Customs Act.
Harmonized System: The classification of goods is determined based on the Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System established by the World Customs Organization.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is defined as the National Board of Revenue constituted under the President’s Order of 1972.
Person: The term person refers to the definition provided in the relevant section of the Customs Act 1969.
Ruling Holder: A ruling holder is any person in whose favor an advance ruling has been issued.

Harmonized System: Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System

Advance Ruling: The term Advance Ruling refers to a ruling issued under the specific sub-rule pertaining to the application process defined in these rules.
Advance Ruling Unit: The Advance Ruling Unit is defined as the body established under the provisions of rule 4 to handle advance ruling matters.
Identical Goods: Identical goods are defined as products that share the same physical characteristics, quality, and reputation as the goods under classification assessment, with only minor aesthetic differences that do not affect classification.
To qualify as identical, the goods must also be produced in the same country as the goods under assessment.
Customs Act 2023: The term Act is defined as the Customs Act 2023 (Act No. 57 of 2023).
Advance Ruling Application: An application refers to a formal request submitted under the specific rule governing the submission of requests for advance rulings.
Applicant: An applicant is defined as any person who submits a request to the National Board of Revenue seeking an advance ruling.
Customs, Excise and VAT Appellate Tribun: The Tribunal is defined as the Customs, Excise and VAT Appellate Tribunal established under section 225 of the Customs Act 2023.
Goods Description: The classification of goods refers to the determination of a product's category based on the Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System established by the World Customs Organization.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is defined as the National Board of Revenue constituted under the National Board of Revenue Order, 1972.
Ruling Holder: A ruling holder is defined as any person in whose favor an advance ruling has been officially issued.

Customs, Excise and VAT Appellate Tribun: Customs, Excise and VAT Appellate Tribunal
Goods Description: Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System
